From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@medbridge.com>, MedBridge Procurement <procurement@medbridge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MedBridge — post-demo cost recap & $/1M competitive snapshot

Hi Julia / team,

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier — good to see the product flows and where the model fits in your triage + summarization pipeline. Quick write-up of what we captured and the immediate asks so we can keep momentum: 

What we captured (please confirm):
- Steady-state inference volume: ~60–80M tokens / month
- Peak / burst window: up to ~180–220M tokens (short periods)
- Embeddings (metadata/semantic search) volume: ~10–15M tokens / month
- Primary model profile: instruction-tuned, chat-like responses (avg response length ~750 tokens)
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for interactive flows

Budget / target unit economics you mentioned:
- Target $/1M tokens (goal for procurement): ~$10 / 1M tokens (you said this was the ballpark you wanted to aim for; confirm)

Immediate asks / next steps from our side:
1) We will send a short competitive $/1M comparison (Redwood reserved vs Redwood on-demand vs OpenAI vs Anthropic vs a cost-optimized open-host) — expected EOD tomorrow.
2) Provide a draft committed-reserved proposal (100M monthly commit + burst profile) that shows blended $/1M and overage rates.
3) Share a simple usage_profile.csv and a mutual-action-plan.md (attached) for you to validate the assumptions (token split, prompt/completion ratio, embedding %).

Questions for you (quick confirmations):
- Is the 60–80M steady-state number conservative or optimistic?
- Any hard constraints from procurement on contract length (12 vs 24 months)?
- Do you need SOC 2 / data residency notes in the proposal up front?

If those look right, can we book 30 minutes Thursday 10am PT to review the price vs host table and the committed offer? I’ll include our pricing lead and solutions Eng.

Thanks — will follow up with the comparator sheet tomorrow.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Book time: https://cal.redwood.com/ben-carter

From: Julia Park <julia.park@medbridge.com>

Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedBridge — post-demo cost recap & $/1M competitive snapshot

Ben — thanks for the recap and clear asks. Confirming the numbers from our side: 

- Steady-state: 60–80M tokens / month (this aligns with our internal telemetry — conservative estimate)
- Peak: we have short daily bursts that could reach ~200–220M on weekdays (agent-driven bulk summaries)
- Embeddings: plan for ~12M tokens / month (search + rerank)
- Model flavor: prefer an instruction-tuned chat model for better context handling
- Target unit price: our procurement target is $10 / 1M tokens; if you can show a committed-reserve path near that number we can escalate internally

Procurement notes: SOC 2 Type II and a brief data-retention/audit section will be required before legal signs off. Contract length preference: 12 months to start.

Yes to a Thursday 10am PT sync — invite sent to your calendar. For the competitive table, please split the per-1M number into: committed-blended, on-demand list, and overage. Also call out any hard caps (throughput/latency) tied to the price tiers.

Thanks — Julia
Julia Park
Head of Product | MedBridge Inc.
julia.park@medbridge.com | (617) 555-0199
